title: Bolsonaro and Lula head to runoff: 5 takeaways from Brazil’s election
summary_full: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva finished first and second in the opening round of Brazil’s presidential election. They'll meet in a runoff on Oct. 25.
